mx_user.description: User under which the multiplexor and filter processes run

mx_log.description: Set to true to enable multiplexor syslog logging

md_allow_group_access.description: Set to true to allow group access to sockets and files

loopback_reserved_connections.description: Number of workers reserved for loopback connections (-1 for default, 0 to queue, >0 to reserve)

allow_new_connections_to_queue.description: Allow new connections to queue if workers are busy

mx_minimum.description: Minimum number of filter worker processes to keep

mx_maximum.description: Maximum number of filter worker processes to run

mx_busy.description: Seconds a process is allowed to scan an email before being considered dead

mx_recipok_perdomain_limit.description: Maximum concurrent recipok requests per domain (0 for unlimited)
